USAGE: swiftjls-cli [OPTIONS] <command> [OPTIONS]

COMMANDS
  capabilities [--json]      Report actual library support (currently empty).
  help [command]             Show global or command-specific help.
  version                    Show the development version.
  encode, decode, inspect, validate
                            Native scalar JPEG-LS and bounded NRRD stream operations.

Requires Swift 6.2 or newer; Apple OS baseline 26.0. CLI hosts: macOS/Linux.
Lossless and near-lossless greyscale; advanced extensions remain unsupported.

OPTIONS
  -h, --help                 Show this help; also: help [command].
  --version                  Show the development version.
  -v, -vv ... -vvvvv         Increase verbosity (maximum 5).
  --verbose LEVEL           Set verbosity to 1..5 or + through +++++.
  --verbose=LEVEL            Equivalent explicit form; -verbose: LEVEL is accepted.
  -q, --quiet                Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible.

VERBOSITY (stderr only; default 0)
  1 summary; 2 command stages; 3 capability details; 4 elapsed timing;
  5 bounded diagnostic trace. Levels are cumulative. Quiet conflicts with verbosity.
  Payload bytes, metadata, raw addresses and input/output paths are never logged.

EXIT STATUS
  0 success/help/version; 2 invalid usage; 4 unsupported codec operation;
  6 I/O failure (including a closed pipe); 3 malformed input;
  5 resource/deadline; 7 internal failure; 130 cancellation.

MANUAL
  man swiftjls-cli (installed with the executable by Scripts/install-cli.sh).

EXAMPLES
  swiftjls-cli -h
  swiftjls-cli help capabilities

commands.stdout:
USAGE: swiftjls-cli encode --input PATH [OPTIONS]

Native scalar JPEG-LS. Encode reads attached 2D raw uint16 NRRD.
Decode writes that NRRD profile and requires 16 meaningful source bits.
Inspect validates headers; validate decodes the complete sample payload.
Unsupported layouts and metadata fail explicitly.

  -i, --input PATH           Input or '-' for standard input.
  --input-format FORMAT     nrrd for encode; jls otherwise.
  -o, --output PATH           Final output or '-'; --overwrite permits replacement.
  --output-format FORMAT      jls for encode; nrrd for decode.
  --mode lossless|near-lossless  Default lossless.
  --max-error N               Required for near-lossless; 1...255.
  --backend NAME            automatic (default) or scalar-cpu.
  --copy-policy POLICY      require-sharing (default) or allow-copy.
  --threads N               Worker ceiling; scalar codec uses one worker.
  --max-memory BYTES        Operation memory ceiling (default 1 GiB).
  --timeout SECONDS         Positive deadline (default 120).
  --json                    JSON on stdout for inspect/validate;
                            encode/decode reports on stderr.
Pipe serialisation involves copies. Binary stdout may contain partial
output after failure; file transactions are removed on failure.

OPTIONS
  -h, --help                 Show this help; also: help [command].
  --version                  Show the development version.
  -v, -vv ... -vvvvv         Increase verbosity (maximum 5).
  --verbose LEVEL           Set verbosity to 1..5 or + through +++++.
  --verbose=LEVEL            Equivalent explicit form; -verbose: LEVEL is accepted.
  -q, --quiet                Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible.

VERBOSITY (stderr only; default 0)
  1 summary; 2 command stages; 3 capability details; 4 elapsed timing;
  5 bounded diagnostic trace. Levels are cumulative. Quiet conflicts with verbosity.
  Payload bytes, metadata, raw addresses and input/output paths are never logged.

  6 I/O failure (including a closed pipe); 3 malformed input;
  5 resource/deadline; 7 internal failure; 130 cancellation.

SWIFTJLS-CLI(1)          Swift Image Compression Suite         SWIFTJLS-CLI(1)

N NA AM ME E
       swiftjls-cli - native scalar JPEG-LS codec

S SY YN NO OP PS SI IS S
       s sw wi if ft tj jl ls s- -c cl li i [_ o_ p_ t_ i_ o_ n_ s] _ c_ o_ m_ m_ a_ n_ d [_ o_ p_ t_ i_ o_ n_ s]

D DE ES SC CR RI IP PT TI IO ON N
       Native scalar lossless and near-lossless JPEG-LS for unsigned
       greyscale.  The library supports 2 through 16 meaningful bits in 8-bit
       or 16-bit storage.  Build with Swift 6.2 or newer in Swift 6 language
       mode. Apple OS minimum is 26.0.  CLI hosts are macOS and Linux; consult
       qualification records for executed coverage.

       JPEG-LS input permits one zero byte after an odd-length complete
       codestream for DICOM even padding. Other trailing bytes, concatenated
       streams and missing EOI are malformed. Padding counts against input
       limits. Input is an extracted codestream, not a DICOM container.

C CO OM MM MA AN ND DS S
       c ca ap pa ab bi il li it ti ie es s [ [- -- -j js so on n] ]
              Report actual library encode/decode/inspect support. JSON is one
              document on stdout.  False support values and empty formats mean
              unavailable algorithms.

       h he el lp p [ [c co om mm ma an nd d] ]
              Show global or command-specific help. No arguments also show
              global help.

       v ve er rs si io on n
              Show the development version.

O OP PT TI IO ON NS S
       - -h h, , - -- -h he el lp p
              Show help, including after a command.

       - -- -v ve er rs si io on n
              Show the development version.

       - -v v, , - -v vv v, , - -v vv vv v, , - -v vv vv vv v, , - -v vv vv vv vv v
              Increase diagnostic verbosity, up to 5.

       - -- -v ve er rb bo os se e L LE EV VE EL L, , - -- -v ve er rb bo os se e= =L LE EV VE EL L
              Set level to 1 through 5, or + through +++++. Bare verbose
              increments once.

       - -v ve er rb bo os se e: : L LE EV VE EL L, , - -v ve er rb bo os se e: :L LE EV VE EL L
              Equivalent explicit verbosity spelling; bare -verbose increments
              once.

       - -q q, , - -- -q qu ui ie et t
              Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible. Conflicts
              with verbosity.

D DI IA AG GN NO OS ST TI IC C L LE EV VE EL LS S
       Default 0 reports errors only. Levels are cumulative: 1 summary; 2
       stages; 3 capability/configuration details; 4 elapsed timing; 5 bounded
       trace. Invalid levels or totals above 5 return 2.  Explicit levels set
       and repeated flags increment in argument order.  Diagnostics use
       stderr. Requested help/version/capability data uses stdout.  No payload
       bytes, metadata, raw addresses or input/output paths are logged.

C CO OD DE EC C C CO OM MM MA AN ND DS S
       encode reads attached raw 2D uint16 NRRD and writes JPEG-LS.  decode
       reads JPEG-LS and writes NRRD, requiring 16 meaningful bits.  inspect
       checks headers and reports dimensions and precision.  validate also
       decodes the complete sample payload.

       Use -i/--input and -o/--output for files or a single hyphen for
       streams.  Input/output formats are nrrd and jls as applicable to the
       command.  Use --mode lossless (default) or near-lossless with --max-
       error 1 through 255.  The scalar backend uses one worker; --threads is
       a ceiling.  Copy policy is require-sharing by default; allow-copy is
       also accepted.  Use --max-memory BYTES and --timeout SECONDS to set
       finite limits.  Defaults are 1 GiB and 120 seconds. Both must be
       positive.

       Existing output is refused unless --overwrite is supplied.  Files use a
       sibling transaction and atomic publication; incomplete files are
       removed.  Binary stdout cannot be rolled back. A failed stream may
       contain partial bytes.  JSON inspect/validate output uses stdout;
       encode/decode JSON reports use stderr.  Pipe serialisation involves
       copies, independently of in-process shared storage.

       The NRRD profile requires explicit endian and permits no detached
       references, compression, colour, signed samples or ancillary
       interpretation fields.  Lower meaningful precision cannot be silently
       widened for NRRD output.
